environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_HEADER override to COUNT, (2) a custom rule 'restrict-header-content' using a RegexPatternSet that matches the X-Page-Size header value against pattern '^[0-9]{1,4}$' with action BLOCK if NOT matched (i.e., the rule uses NotStatement wrapping RegexPatternSetReferenceStatement on SingleHeader 'x-page-size', action BLOCK), (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet in default BLOCK mode. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm all three rule groups are actively evaluating traffic.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAFv2 WebACL association
config.network: Private subnet, ALB in public subnet
